title: French Drain Installation Contract
description: Standard contract template for French drain installation projects with excavation, perforated drainage pipe, gravel surround, and surface restoration

scope_template.project_description: French drain installation with excavation, perforated drainage pipe, drain rock surround, and drainage junction connection. Contractor excavates {{trench_dimensions}} trench running approximately {{drain_length_ew}}' from east to west on northern boundary of backyard, and {{drain_length_ns}}' from north to south. Contractor perforates concrete housing of drainage junction, installs French drain with {{rock_size}} drain rock and {{pipe_size}} ADS, draining into existing drainage junction. Contractor disposes of excavation tailings.
scope_items: Perforate concrete drainage housing at junction point
Install French drain with perforated {{pipe_size}} ADS pipe
Surround drain with {{rock_size}} drain rock and weed barrier fabric
Connect to existing drainage junction with proper fall

materials.description: Border Concepts flex steel, black, 13 gauge, 10'

standard_terms: Work schedule subject to weather conditions
Customer responsible for marking underground utilities (call 811 before work begins)
Changes to scope of work require written authorization and may affect pricing
Contractor not responsible for damage to unmarked utilities or existing irrigation lines
Customer grants access to property during project duration
usage_notes: This template is designed for standard French drain installations
Adjust pipe size (3" or 4") based on drainage volume requirements
Rock size typically 1.5" for residential applications
Labor rates: $72/hr for excavation/general, $85/hr for technical work
Optional edging can be included for aesthetic finish
Trench dimensions typically 9"x9" for residential, adjust for commercial
Consider soil conditions when estimating excavation time
